column1: # Function names of the Ghidra program (ORAS_ENGINE.md 6), applied by ApplyNames.java: address, name, role, read|guess.
# "read": the code shows the role; "guess": named from context. Subsystem prefixes: Zone_ Map_ Event_ Field_ Script_ Res_ Mem_
# Gfx_ Snd_ Text_ Save_ Util_ Sys_. A module address is its linked one (cro_link.py: DllField at 0x10242000).
# Zone change (7 October): the 782 functions entering a zone runs that walking does not (coverage_map.py), read by sub-agents.

column3: Copies 0x40 bytes from the source's second word into the object at +0xDF22.
Copies up to n 16-bit chars, padding with the terminator once the source ends.
If non-null, frees a block using the size/heap words stored 8 and 4 bytes before it.
Calls a destructor callback on each element of an array from last to first and returns the allocation header (base-8).
Appends at most n chars of a string to a NUL-terminated string (strncat).
Finds the first occurrence of one byte string inside another (strstr).
Returns whether byte 1 of the sub-object at +0x178 is non-zero.
Lazily initialises a static 3x4 identity-like matrix (guard flag) and copies it to the argument.
Stops every slot in an object's 0x2C-byte animation slot table (count at +0xAC) via FUN_0014d550.

Constructs a script context: vtable, heap at +0x84, the 0x78-byte Pawn state at +4 cleared, +0x7C/+0x88 and the status halfwords +0x8C/+0x8E zeroed (the layout Script_Load uses). Was guessed Util_ObjectInitWithBuffer.
Allocates a handle and opens archive 13 (zones), or reuses a shared one when the flag is set.
If active, stops/releases the current entry of a 0x9C-byte stream table and clears its slot.

Initialises the current thread's TLS block fields from the thread ID register.
Returns the size of an archive member (wraps FUN_001287bc).
Sets byte 1 of entry i (0x2C-byte rows) of an object's table if the entry is active and in range.
Starts the animation in slot i of the 0x2C-byte slot table with a given loop flag and resets its frame.

Clears bit N in the flag bitfield (flags <0xD00 in object at +0x2F4, 0x3000-0x303F in a global table).

Constructs a UTF-16 string buffer of given capacity allocated from a heap.
Resets a vtable and releases the owned object at +4 if present.
Zeroes and resets a large state object (vectors, 4 sub-blocks via FUN_0012c370, buffers at 0x8A4); likely camera/controller reset.
Returns 1 when the animation in slot i is absent, stopped or has reached its last frame.
Returns the file count (u16 at +2) of a container header.
Returns a pointer to the 16-bit script work variable 0x4000+i (0 if out of range).
Returns a memory region base/size for a region id 0x20000/0x30000.
Thread start routine: clears TLS, runs the init/entry callbacks, then exits the thread (svc 9).
LZ10/LZ11 (header-type nibble) decompressor into a destination buffer.
Reads a 24-bit size from a header, falling back to the next 32-bit word when zero (LZ header style).
Reads a 24-bit size from a compression header, using the extended word when zero.
Initialises a small parameter struct (volume 0x7F, pan 0x40) to defaults.

Clears a UTF-16 string buffer to empty.
Reads string #n of a message data file (bank-selected, cached or streamed) into a string buffer.
Starts an async read job of a file at a priority (clamped to 31), aborting on failure.

Expands a message's 0x10 control codes (sub-messages, plural/gender selection, word buffers) into an output string.
Sets entry i of a 12-byte-entry table (bounds checked, fatal error otherwise).
Copies a message string into a UTF-16 buffer, XOR-decrypting it with a rolling key when encrypted.
Allocates from a heap object at its tail (negative alignment) via FUN_0012b9a0.
Stops the animation in slot i of the 0x2C-byte slot table and resets its frame.
Returns the command word of a 0x10 control tag in a text string, else 0.
Returns parameter i of a 0x10 control tag in a text string, else 0.
If a chunk starts with tag 0x10, returns the pointer past it.
Copies one string buffer into another, storing the resulting length.
Appends a 16-bit char to a bounded string buffer and keeps it 0-terminated.
Counts characters of a 16-bit encoded string, skipping 0x10 control-code payloads, capped at 0x800.
Copies a UTF-16 string with 0x10 control tags up to a max length; returns length.

Constructor: sets vtable and clears four fields.

Sets a script work value (index <100 word, <200 halfword) and returns it.

Returns a pointer to a 0x38-byte entry selected by format bits, or a default.

Stops every channel in a list (FUN_0018ecf0(ch,1)) and clears the playing flags.

Runs a destructor-step then frees the object (operator delete wrapper).
Maps each animation member to a model node index by name lookup, filling an index table.
Resolves a list of named entries to indices via a name dictionary, filling unresolved slots with a sentinel.
Sets an array pointer/count and fills every 16-bit entry with a constant.
Reserves an aligned block from a running offset and returns offset and size.
Pads a parsed block to 16-byte alignment with zeros and records its word count.
Resolves model/material texture and shader references by name in a resource dictionary, returning error bits for missing ones.
Builds per-material shader binding blocks (TexMtx0-2, TexTran, TexcMap, MatAmbi, MatDiff) for a model resource.
Validates a model/texture resource header (version, alignment) and initializes its runtime object.
Applies a table of typed relocation entries to segments (module/shader-binary patching).
Sets a scene node flag and propagates it to children and attached nodes via vtables.
Searches a resource dictionary (12-byte entries) for a name, returning the entry.
Copies up to N UTF-16 characters into a text buffer at a position and marks it dirty.
Copies texture/sampler parameters (wrap modes, sizes) into a render descriptor.
Builds a local render state, applies pending settings and submits it.
Renders a text object's string when non-empty (glyph setup and draw calls).
Calls FUN_0017a8e8 with the object's +4 and +8 fields.
Gets a node via vtable 0x18 and sets its byte +0xE to the inverse of the flag (hidden).
Stops five sound/channel slots 0-4 and two more by id.
Returns the result of vtable slot 8.
Clears an object's back-pointer and the owner's link slot at +0x29E0 when it points to it.
Checks an object's runtime type chain and attaches it to the holder on match.
Copies four 13-byte light entries from a descriptor and configures lighting/fog for a scene environment.
Returns 1 when the field at +0xC is non-null.
Resets a sound manager object and its four channel slots.
Fills a request of type 0x26 with player parameters and posts it to a command queue.
Queues a render command (type 0x27) with two parameters.
When a dirty flag is set, clears it and recomputes the object's derived state.
Stops every queued player in 3 lists whose id matches.
Waits on a kernel handle and calls a completion callback when signalled.
Frees a buffer held by the object if it is owned and allocated.
Constructs an async file request: opens a path, gets its size, allocates and calls a completion callback on failure.
Returns the value if 0 or 1, else 3.
Stores two values and resets two handles to -1 on a sound source object.
Seek on a stream object: whence 0=set, 1=cur, 2=end, or forwards to the inner stream.
Initialises a small handle struct with defaults and -1 indexes.
Reads a 0x40-byte header from a stream, validates it, reads the full file and parses its info.
Validates a binary header magic/version and records its data pointer.
Zeros words 1 and 2 of an object.
Sets a byte field and marks the object dirty (flag 2) when it changes.
Resets an object's state fields after a base reset call.
Parses a texture/graphics container header and sets up its layer entries.
Destroys all nodes of an object's linked list and releases its inner handle.
Builds a message of type 0xF with a computed state byte and posts it to a queue.
Gets the sound manager and stops players with the given id.
Resets a sound player: volume 0x7F, pan 0x40 on 4 tracks, clears 8 voice slots.
Stops a sound object's players and releases its tracks.
Sets a visibility flag and propagates it to every 0x340-byte child entry.
Per-frame update of the multi-track player: refreshes voices and volume/mute state once.
Frees a sound object's voice blocks and tracks and marks it unloaded.
Computes quad corners and UVs from a glyph/sprite rect and issues GPU commands.
Clears counters of the object at +0x44.
Stores 1/width and 1/height of a texture-like object (vtable +8/+0xC) as floats.
Polls a stream's status and advances a volume/pitch accumulator.
Initialises a parameter block with -1 ids and default float values.
Returns its argument.
Builds a GPU command list for a batch of sorted draw items (material/texture state changes, uniforms).
Writes pending GPU uniform/register commands (matrices, lights) into a command buffer.
Frees a block (forwards to FUN_002ff8c0).
Clears byte +0x12 of a struct (status init).
Calls a stop function on every track whose owner id matches.
Swaps between two models/resources at +0x24/+0x28 by flag, loading/attaching one and detaching the other.
Returns word +0xC of an object.
Returns 1 if a resource descriptor has no file id or its file exists in the container.
Decompresses data by header type: 0x10 LZ, 0x20 Huffman, 0x30 RLE, 0x40/0x50 extended LZ (needs heap).
Finishes an async read job: waits for the file, invokes its completion callback once and signals.
Advances an async read job by reading the next chunk (raw or compressed modes) and completes it when done.
Finishes an async job: closes the file if needed and calls its completion callback.
Ticks the async loading system (two update calls).
Allocates a 0x54-byte async read job for a file with callback and starts it.
Returns 1 while a pending load job is busy, else destroys the job and returns 0.
Gets a member's offset/size in an archive and starts an async load of it.
Returns 1 when an async load job has finished (destroying it), 0 while busy.
If the stream is open, reads via FUN_001326f4 and reports error codes; returns bytes read.
Writes a byte flag into the object's sub-structure (+5).
Empty function.
Stores a value at +4 then calls vtable slot 0x18.
Stores a value at +0x3C only if the slot is empty, returning whether it did.
Frees a model/texture resource slot's buffers and resets its state to defaults (0x10000).
Once per object, allocates a 0x34 bind block, resolves six resource offsets and allocs buffers then binds them (FUN_0031fc24).
Binds a model's resources and attaches animations, returning whether binding succeeded (flag 4).
Resolves each of a model's referenced resources once, setting bound/ok flags.
Binds animation resources to a model's nodes once, setting a ready flag.
Initialises a two-word object with its vtable and a null pointer.
Empty function.
Removes an object from a scene list and clears its slot bit in a bitmap.
Finds a free bit in a bitmap, marks it, appends the object to a list and stores its index.
Walks a packed u32 command list and dispatches each entry to visitor vtable callbacks (+8/+0xC/+0x10/+0x14).
Binds an animation (skeletal/material/visibility type) to a model and returns a status code.
Resets a material/state block's colour values and halfword table to defaults.
Sizes and allocates a per-channel buffer from the largest bound animation curve and stores its type.
For a non-DefaultShader material, allocates uniform entries and binds them by name/index.
Destructor freeing an array of owned resources and clearing fields.
Destructor: frees three animation slot buffers and clears them.
Reads a material's "PrivateMod" user-data and render-state words into a render state block.
Clears six 0x24-byte entries and related light/fog state.
Frees the pointer array at +0x16C, resets counts and calls base cleanup.
Releases the handle at +0x10 if set and resets fields to empty (-1/0).
Initializes a 0x1C-byte animation controller object (vtable, index -1).
Runs successive base-class reset methods on an object (constructor/destructor chain).
Looks up a name in the model dictionary at +0x40 and passes the index (or -1) to virtual +0x18.
Resets an animation controller's index to -1 and clears its resource.
Initializes a 0x10-byte animation controller object (vtable, index -1).
Runs the destructor chain of an object and frees it.
Allocates N 0x3C-byte animation entries for a model and binds each to a resource.
Reads the _EdgeType/_EdgeMapAlphaMask user data of a material and configures edge/outline render state for it.
Registers a model in a scene group's slot list, cloning group membership bits.
Finds a scene-group node matching a key and sets a bit in its mask, returning the single set index.
Releases the 7 sub-objects of each 0x20-byte entry then frees three arrays.
Unlinks a model from the scene group lists it belongs to and frees its slot.
Resets a state struct and clears its bitmask buffer.
Sets fields to 1 and 4.
Destructor: frees two buffers and an owned object, then itself.
Stores an xyz vector at +0xF4 of an object and sets a dirty flag.
Looks up shader uniforms WrldMtx, NormMtx, ProjMtx, ViewMtx, LightCt, UnivReg, Hsl*, MatAmbi, MatDiff.
Forwards an animation bind to the model's animation set at +0x13C if present.
Assigns an animation into slot n of a model object.
Builds a per-bone mapping table between a model skeleton and a skeleton resource.
Allocates a holder with an n-pointer array (zeroed) on a model.
Finds a named parameter in a material and sets it to a 4-float value.
Forwards a parameter to the model's material i, returning 6 if absent.
Builds per-material GPU command buffers (colors, blend, textures) for a model.
Sets a per-material/per-pass byte flag in the model's 0x174-byte material table.
Instantiates a model from a resource: copies root matrix, allocates mesh/material/skeleton buffers and per-material state.
Tears down a model instance: frees animations, buffers, unregisters from scene, resets fields.
Releases a model instance: removes it from scene groups, frees buffers and resets its state.
Copies a 3-float vector into the object at +0xE8.
Resets a movement/transform state block (positions, scales to defaults).
Constructor: sets vtable, resets fields to defaults and registers the node with a global manager.
Constructor: sets vtable, base init, and registers with a global manager list.
Tears down if already set up, stores params and calls four virtual setup stages, marking it initialized.
Calls the object's update virtual and clears the busy flag when a sub-animation ends.
Requests an async load of member N of an archive when the async system is idle.
Clears a 0x184-byte buffer (second argument) and calls the handler object at +0x34 (virtual +0x10) with it. Was guessed Util_MemClear0x184 from code cut short.
Waits on/cancels a pending async load and frees its buffer, resetting the request.
Gets a member's size (FUN_001287bc), allocates a buffer and starts an async (mode 1) or sync read.
Builds two small command packets (8 and 0x18 bytes) and submits each via FUN_0016dfe8.
Frees the two owned pointers at +4 and +0 and clears them.
Destroys an object then frees its memory.
Applies animation to model slot i depending on its animation kind (1/2/3).
Returns 1 if slot index is in range and its entry at +0x658 is not active per FUN_0032b2a4.
Starts a fade in/out of a slot entry over a given frame count, setting its fade state at +0x9D.
Destructor: frees an owned buffer then deletes the object.
Destructor releasing each 0x14-byte entry's object and freeing the lists.
Empty function.
Destructor of the file reader: closes the kernel handle (SVC 0x23/0x24) and frees owned objects.
Sets a 4-float vector from two constants (x,y,z, w).
Computes ellipse focus points and perimeter-like sum from semi-axes.
Calls the script VM (FUN_00503308) on a function index and keeps resuming (-2) while it yields (code 0xC); returns the result.
Finds a script's public variable by name (Sys_FindSymbolByNameHash) and returns its address, or 0: used for g_mode, g_interactive_flag, g_ai_flag. Was guessed Res_Dictionary_Lookup.

Loads a script into a context: frees the old image, clears the 0x78-byte Pawn state at +4, copies the image to the heap, prepares it (Script_InitImage) and registers the natives every script gets: Pawn core (0x5032F8), printf (0x505F24), float (0x505AAC) and _Suspend (table 0x5A6758). Was guessed Snd_SequenceReset.
Returns -3 if no VM loaded, counts down a wait counter, otherwise calls virtual +0x10.
Returns -3 with no script loaded; counts down the _Suspend wait at +0x88 (-1), otherwise steps the script through its virtual +0x10. Was guessed Gfx_AnimState_Step.
Runs the script (Script_VmCall from main) until it ends (0) or sleeps (0xC); returns -1 while a _Suspend wait at +0x88 counts down. Was guessed Snd_SequenceStep.
Finds a script's public function by name hash (Script_FindSymbolByHash); returns its index or -1. Was guessed Util_HashMapFind.
Destructor: resets vtable and frees the VM buffer at +4.
Parses a skeleton blob: bones, parent links, names and transforms into joint arrays.
Recomputes world matrices of a chain of joints from their parents.
Destructor freeing several owned buffers of a graphics resource object.
Allocates a 0xE8-byte block on the given heap and zero-fills it (memclr); no constructor runs.
Optionally copies 0xE8 bytes of state into a block, marks it dirty and re-applies it.
Sets a byte (alpha, clamped to 255) in a material's state block.
Sets bit N (0..63) in a material's 64-bit flag mask.
Constructor: allocates the 0xE8 state object and a 0x10 helper and links them.
Deleting destructor: frees its two buffers and helper object, then itself.
Returns element i (0..5) of a 6-word array, fatal if out of range.

Script_Load, then the context points to itself at +0x48 and the field natives of .code table 0x57A860 (_FadeRequestIn...) are linked; every caller then registers the zone's tables (Script_RegisterNativeTablesByMask). Was guessed Snd_SequenceStart.
Pushes a joint out of up to 7 collision spheres ("too many collision balls" otherwise).
Stores two bytes and three scaled floats (from integer inputs) into a struct.
Initializes a 0x60-byte light/effect object from integer angles.
Sets visibility flags of an effect and updates its emitters.
Parses a count-prefixed byte list into 16-byte entries (node pointer + two scaled values) and links them to matching skeleton nodes.
Parses a flag-driven descriptor (sections 1,2,4,8,0x10,0x20,0x40) into an effect object.
Initializes a model instance from its resource: per-node attributes, bounds and per-bone chain links.
Parses a counted list of entries into one or more 0x24-byte groups split by distinct target, allocating from a heap.
Allocates a light of type 1..10 from a descriptor record.
Destroys a map/terrain object's sub-objects, models and buffers.
Loads a zone header and returns its map/area id, with special cases by flag 0x4000 and zone 0x2D.
Chooses a value for a zone by checking event flags against a 0x54-entry table.
Looks the new zone number up in a 3-entry table (flag-gated) and plays its sound/BGM with fade 30.
If a handle is set, releases it via FUN_00450274(h,0x1E) and invalidates it.
Loads the new zone header, picks the zone's BGM and, if different from the current one, queues a fade-out/fade-in sequence change.
Files a loaded map piece into the first free slot with its cell word and tags its sub-objects.
Frees the map-piece slots matching a cell word and clears references to them.
Checks a buffer starts with an expected 8-byte magic, else fatal error.
Switch on a value type that formats a value (number, name, zone name via zone header etc.) into a text buffer.
Copies the rows of a fixed 85-entry 0x14-byte table whose either id matches into a buffer and counts them.
Counts ticks and calls a callback each time the period elapses.
Sets save event flags tied to a zone number from two static tables.
Returns file i of one of the zone data containers kept by the zone loader (+0x94C0 slots).
Polls the zone-header async load and, once done, indexes the loaded zone data.
Loads zone header n (<0x218): either from the resident 0x38-byte table or by starting an async read of the zone archive member; fatal on bad size.
Swaps the current and pending zone data container slots and updates the current zone id.
Releases the zone header loader's file object.
Sets fields of 0x30-byte character entry i of an events set if it has no live object yet.
Copies a zone's events file into the 0xC84 buffer and sets pointers/counts for furniture, characters, warps, triggers.
Sets parameters on character event i (0x30-byte rows) if it is of type 1.
Sets visited/fly flags for the current zone using tables keyed by zone id.
Sets a field character's 0x2C-byte transform, updates its dirty flag and, if collision is enabled, its collision shape.
Tests whether two field objects touch/face each other within range, for interaction or collision.
Finds the field-manager character entry (0xAB0 bytes) matching an event row, or allocates a free one and initialises it.
Gets a character's 0x18-byte model info by model id from a cache, then from already-placed characters (0xAB0 pool), else reads it from the archive.
Requests loading of a character model id unless already loaded or already present in the pool.
For each active character entry (0xAB0 bytes) not belonging to the zone, releases it; others get timer 2000.
Spawns each 0x30-byte character record whose flag is unset into the field manager pool (max 26), fatal on overflow.
Per-character update: runs its behaviour function from a 23-entry table and lazily creates its model.
Initializes a character entry's movement/model sub-components once.
Computes a placed character's position/rotation matrices from its event record (grid or rail coords, special case for type 0x2009).
Copies a zone event's character entry (id, model, position, movement fields) into a 0xAB0 character object and fetches its model info.

Sets a character entry's model parameters (+0x9A0): copies a given 0x40-byte record of halfwords to +0x9AC, or for character types 0x78 and 0x96 (types 0x7A-0x89 read from event work first) builds a 12-byte descriptor from the record's +0xE and +0x12 and applies it (0x49E794). Was guessed Event_CharacterAbort from code cut short.
Detaches a character entry's model/animation objects and resets its state.
Destroys a script holder (Script_VmHolderDestructor) and frees it. Was guessed Event_CharacterFree.

Links a loaded script's natives: for each bit of a mask (1 to 0x400) gets one native table {name, function} (through the .code's import stubs 0x19C8C8-0x19C910 to DllField's getters, bit 0x200 a .code table) and passes it to Sys_LinkImportsByNameHash. Was guessed Snd_PlayEffectsByMask.

Counts a zone's character slots and, for up to 8, creates a script context (Script_Context_Construct) and a script manager (Event_CreateScriptManager). Was guessed Gfx_LoadCharacterModels (0x3FE45C is the script manager, not an archive request).
For 8 slots, frees attached sub-objects and clears matching in-use flags, then destroys each.
Resolves a script argument: ids 0x4000-0x7FFF read event work values, 0x8000-0xBFFF script-local temps, else the literal.
Constructs a field event/character manager and its id table.
Releases a script context's sub-object and buffer.
Returns a global value pair (0 when the global is unset).
Creates a script context and runner, starts a script with a mode value (g_mode) and sets work variables.
Clears flag 0x9000 on a render object and bit0 of its state.
Resets script/event state on zone change: stops running scripts, clears local work values and flags.
Checks that a pending zone script is loaded and starts it once.
Empty function.

Loads a zone's script: stores the zone at +0x38, takes its native mask from the 536-word table 0x587D58, Script_LoadFieldScript, Script_RegisterNativeTablesByMask, then calls the script's public GetSceneChangeData with 0, 1, 2... and keeps up to 8 (value, u16, u16) triples until it returns -1. Was guessed Field_RunScriptReadTriplets.
